answer: Glacier-layered bond: each identity posts three layers locking 20, 10, 60 credits, the deepest glacier-paced. Each layer files a 5-credit attestation with an echo of the one below; a hollow layer breaks the echo. Auditors replay 5% of chains; a mismatch burns all three. Rented layers fail: only 10-epoch-old layers may echo; backing a burned stack costs 20. Each identity costs 105: 1,000 fakes cost 105,000 vs 40,000 pool; honest agents pay once.
